ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: Aftermath Rites
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Defs-only companion to `mandrake.rm.aftermath`: the eight `RM_AftermathRuleDef`s from design/Jawa/proposals/plot_mechanisms_wave.md §2.1, each naming a real Ash'karr faction, an existing vanilla `IncidentDef` payload, and a Ninefold god tie. Carries no C#, no engine logic — the engine (trigger evaluation, delay/telegraph scheduling, incidentQueue dispatch) lives in `mandrake.rm.aftermath`; this mod only supplies the campaign-specific rule DATA, per this project's engine/content tier split.
